citation: Jiang, Grefenstette, Rocktaschel, Prioritized Level Replay, ICML 2021
published_rule: score-driven replay over a fixed finite training-level support with a staleness mixture

mapping.training_level: one frozen DRTP group; PLR reweights the six failure groups only
mapping.within_group_member_draw: unchanged uniform draw from the existing frozen group members
mapping.score_source: mean absolute unnormalised GAE from vectorised training-rollout fragments only

fairness: same fixed endpoint tape and episodes
